Name: Sensor death and frozen traffic telemetry
Description: A downtown traffic counter freezes during rush hour while an industrial temperature sensor abruptly dies.
Expected: Twin: DTN-TRF-01 holds its pre-fault reported value (48) with status OK while its private actual input is 55; IND-TMP-01 reports null with status FAILED; registered backup IND-TMP-02 reports 70. A Brain-role priority command to the supported linked signal DTN-TLT-01 is rejected with SCENARIO_GUARDIAN_PENDING because DTN-TRF-01 is untrusted and has no registered backup. Supplying unrelated industrial sensor IND-TMP-02 does not clear the traffic safety gate. CityCore revision and actuator state do not change.
Expected: Guardian: The Twin emits a pending marker for an untrusted sensor-linked command. No Guardian service or autonomous Guardian verdict is run by this scenario; real Guardian behavior is NOT VERIFIED.
Expected: Brain: No Brain service or autonomous Brain decision is run by this scenario. Controlled local Brain-role calls targeting DTN-TLT-01 are rejected because the linked frozen traffic sensor has no registered backup; the unrelated IND-TMP-02 reading cannot authorize the command. No actuator fallback is claimed. Real Brain behavior is NOT VERIFIED.
How to verify: Run live_tests.test_scenario_orchestration.ScenarioOrchestrationTests.test_scn03_rejects_signal_command_without_linked_traffic_backup and tools/run_scenario_campaign.py. Inspect the SCN-03 scenario campaign JSON, Twin events, and audit log. The campaign commands are controlled local TwinFacade calls, not real partner responses.
